headline_seed: Man arrested after boat capsizes near Statue of Liberty killing woman and infant - BBC
draft_text:
A boat capsized near Liberty Island Aug. 8. A 27-year-old woman and a five-month-old girl died. The 46-year-old operator faces 13 counts of reckless endangerment. BBC News and The Guardian confirm roughly a dozen others were rescued.

And that's the mews.
